biggest_catch: This is cashback on spending, not free money: you must make a Qualifying Purchase (debit or credit card) and complete the Shake 'N' Bank activity in the MoneyLion app. Rewards range $0.01 up to 5x the purchase amount, capped at $500 per Qualified Purchase, set by a randomized weighted algorithm — most rewards are small.
catches: You must have a MoneyLion account and complete the Shake 'N' Bank activity in the app before the disclosed time window expires, or the opportunity is lost.
Only Qualifying Purchases count; pending 'credit'-transaction rewards expire if the purchase does not settle within 14 days of authorization.
Reward size is randomized ($0.01 to 5x purchase, max $500 per Qualified Purchase); smaller rewards are more frequent.
Cashback is real cash but only redeemable inside your MoneyLion Spend or Advisory account.
MoneyLion can change or end the promotion; transaction data comes from third-party merchants/processors.

eligibility: MoneyLion members with an eligible Spend or Advisory account; must complete the Shake 'N' Bank activity in the app within the disclosed window.
maximize: Fastest path: make a small debit Qualified Purchase, complete the Shake 'N' Bank activity in the MoneyLion app immediately after — rewards are 'credited to your MoneyLion Spend Account or Advisory Account in near real time' (official terms) for debit transactions. Prefer debit over credit to avoid the 14-day settlement-expiry window. Treat it as a rebate on money you were already spending.
notes: Same provider as R0811 (MoneyLion) but a fundamentally faster mechanism: near-real-time cashback vs the referral program's 14-day/60-day tiers. Distinct route.

If you process your Qualified Purchase as a 'debit' transaction, any Cashback Rewards you earn will generally be credited to your MoneyLion Spend Account or Advisory Account in near real time after you complete the Shake 'N' Bank activity.

s2.note: Rewards credited as cash to MoneyLion Spend or Advisory account; near real time for debit transactions.

steps: Open a MoneyLion account (Spend or Advisory) if you don't have one.
Make a Qualifying Purchase with your MoneyLion debit card (debit avoids the 14-day credit-settlement window).
Complete the Shake 'N' Bank activity in the MoneyLion app before the disclosed expiry.
Check your MoneyLion Spend/Advisory account — the cashback reward credits in near real time.
timing: Cashback credited in near real time after completing the Shake 'N' Bank activity (debit transactions); 'credit'-transaction rewards stay pending until the purchase settles (up to 14 days).
when_cash_arrives: Near real time in your MoneyLion Spend/Advisory account after completing the in-app activity on a debit Qualifying Purchase.
